data.name: Backrooms: The Entity
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms: The Entity is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Deep within a distorted and decaying reality, something intelligent is hunting you. It watches, adapts, learns your behavior, and grows more aggressive the longer you survive.

Play alone or with friends as you explore abandoned environments, avoid deadly encounters, and uncover the truth behind the presence lurking within the endless maze.

Features

  • Oppressive and immersive horror atmosphere

  • Proximity voice communication

  • Intelligent and reactive enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty settings

  • Stealth-oriented survival gameplay

  • Large interconnected levels filled with secrets and danger

  • Persistent tension with unpredictable encounters

  • Dynamic visibility system influenced by movement, posture, shadows, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is an original interpretation inspired by the Backrooms concept and does not strictly follow established community lore. It focuses on psychological horror, environmental storytelling, and adaptive enemy behavior to create a tense and unpredictable experience.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud sounds, darkness effects, and intense audiovisual sequences that may affect sensitive players.
